title: Dealer Locator Test
featureSummary: Verify that clicking "Find Dealers" on the homepage reaches the dealer locator page, that the page lists at least 5 top cities, and that selecting a city reaches a results page (DRP) showing more than one dealer, each with name, address and a CTA.
conclusion: All three acceptance criteria pass. Three MINOR issues found: broken network-brand logo images in the Filters panel (BUG-2, reproduced from an earlier run), a rapid-click edge case where the Filters modal briefly intercepts pointer events after applying filters (BUG-1, also reproduced), and a new finding — the "Locate me" geolocation button becomes visible on input focus but keeps tabindex=-1 forever, so keyboard-only users tabbing through the input can never reach it (BUG-3). No BLOCKER/CRITICAL/MAJOR found.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Clicking "Find Dealers" from the homepage navigates to the dealer locator page
The dealer locator page shows a top-cities list with at least 5 cities
Selecting a city reaches a results page (DRP) showing more than one dealer, each with name, address, and a CTA

commentScenarios.summary: qa-agent test: does the sort/filter option on the dealer results page actually reorder the results, or just visually open?
commentScenarios.notes: Confirmed both controls actually mutate the result set (not just visual open/close): Sort by Name reordered the first 8 cards to true alphabetical order and the URL gained ?sort=name; applying the "Oil, Filter and Lube" service filter changed the dealer count from 563 to 103 and the URL gained services[]=_SERVICE_CAR_OIL_FILTER_AND_LUBE. Verified via card-order/count diff and again via a fresh-tab URL-persistence recheck in S11. BUG-2 (broken brand logo icons) found while exercising the Networks facet of the same panel.

scenarios.name: Homepage loads with header, hero widget and footer
steps: Navigate to https://www.michelinman.com/
Dismiss consent banner
Check header, tire-selector hero widget and footer render
scenarios.expected: Page loads with no fatal errors; header, hero widget and footer are all present.
scenarios.actual: Header and tire-selector hero widget (.ts__widget) visible immediately. The real site footer is .ds__layout-footer (134 links) — confirmed present and visible after scrolling; note a decoy empty <footer> element also exists earlier in the DOM (a hidden modal-shell footer template), which must be excluded when locating the real footer.

scenarios.name: "Find Dealers" link is present and visible on the homepage
steps: Search DOM for a link/button matching 'find dealer'
Confirm the auto dealer-locator match, visible, href=/auto/dealer-locator
scenarios.expected: A single, visible "Find Dealers" element pointing at the auto dealer locator path.
scenarios.actual: One <a class="ds__btn"> "Find Dealers" found in the header, href="/auto/dealer-locator", on-screen at (1098,117), directly clickable with no menu to open first. (Distinct from moto/bicycle "Find a Dealer" links elsewhere on the page.)

scenarios.name: Footer link grid renders
steps: Scroll to bottom of homepage
Inspect the .ds__layout-footer container for link count
scenarios.expected: Footer link grid renders with multiple navigable links.
scenarios.actual: .ds__layout-footer renders with 134 links, visible after scrolling into view.

scenarios.name: AC-1 positive: clicking "Find Dealers" navigates to the dealer locator page
steps: Click the "Find Dealers" header link natively
Wait for navigation
Screenshot landed page
scenarios.actual: Navigated to https://www.michelinman.com/auto/dealer-locator, title "Find a Michelin Dealer Near You | Michelin USA". No new console errors beyond the known site-wide CSP/status-log noise (see Observations).

scenarios.name: AC-1 edge: back button after navigating to dealer locator restores the homepage
steps: From the dealer locator page, press browser Back
Verify URL and title
Press Forward again to resume testing
scenarios.expected: Browser returns to https://www.michelinman.com/ with the homepage intact (boundary checklist #10).
scenarios.actual: Back restored https://www.michelinman.com/ (title "Explore Michelin Tires, Products & More | Michelin USA"); Forward returned to /auto/dealer-locator cleanly.

scenarios.name: AC-2 positive: top-cities list has at least 5 cities
steps: On /auto/dealer-locator, query the top-cities list container
Count and list city links
scenarios.actual: Exactly 5 cities found: Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas, Los Angeles, New-York. Meets AC-2 literally ("at least 5"). Note "New-York" is hyphenated — see Observations.

scenarios.name: AC-2/AC-3 edge: first top-city link is keyboard-reachable and Enter navigates to its results page
steps: Focus the first top-city link (Atlanta) directly
Confirm document.activeElement is the link
Press Enter
Verify navigation
scenarios.expected: Enter on the focused city link navigates to that city's dealer results page.
scenarios.actual: Focus confirmed on "Atlanta"; Enter navigated to https://www.michelinman.com/auto/dealer-locator/atlanta.

scenarios.name: AC-3 positive: selecting a city shows more than one dealer, each with name, address, and a CTA
steps: From dealer-locator/atlanta, query .dl__card-dealer.result cards
Extract title, address text and CTA presence per card
scenarios.expected: Results page shows > 1 dealer card, each with a name, an address, and at least one CTA.
scenarios.actual: 20 dealer cards rendered (of 563 total — "563 car tire dealers in Atlanta, GA, USA"). Every sampled card had a title (e.g. "MIDAS", "GORDY TIRE AND AUTOMOTIVE", "THE PEP BOYS-MANNY, MOE & JACK"), a full street address, and a CTA.

scenarios.name: AC-3 edge: searching a nonsense city/zip is handled gracefully
steps: Type "zzzzznonsense99999" into the dealer-search input
Observe autocomplete/result state
scenarios.expected: No crash; no bogus suggestions or errors (boundary checklist #1 empty state, #5 invalid input).
scenarios.actual: No autocomplete suggestions appeared for the nonsense string; input and "Locate me" control remained intact; no new console errors were caused by the action itself (the 10 console errors present at that point are the known site-wide CSP/status-log noise repeated per page load, confirmed by inspecting the full error list).

scenarios.name: Sort and Filter controls actually reorder/refine results, not just visually open
steps: Capture first 8 card titles as baseline on /auto/dealer-locator/atlanta
Click "Sort by: Recommended", select "Name"
Re-capture first 8 card titles, button label and URL
Click "Filters", expand "Services", check "Oil, Filter and Lube", click "See results"
Compare dealer count before/after and inspect URL params
Expand "Networks" facet and check brand logo images
scenarios.expected: Sort reorders the actual result set (not just a label change); filter actually reduces the result set and both are reflected in the URL; all facet logo icons load.
scenarios.actual: Sort: URL gained ?sort=name and titles reordered to true alphabetical order (4 WHEEL PARTS, AKINS CHRYSLER DODGE JEEP RAM, AKINS FORD, ...). Filter: dealer count dropped from 563 to 103, URL gained services%5B%5D=_SERVICE_CAR_OIL_FILTER_AND_LUBE. Both confirmed genuine data mutations, not just UI state. However, the Networks facet's BMW and Audi logo images both 404'd (BUG-2, reproduced from a prior run of this ticket).

scenarios.name: URL persistence: a filtered + sorted results URL restores the same state in a fresh tab
steps: Copy the current filtered+sorted URL (?services[]=...&sort=name)
Open it in a brand-new page in the same browser context
Verify card count, dealer total text and card order
scenarios.expected: Fresh tab on the same URL restores the same filtered, sorted state (boundary checklist #9).
scenarios.actual: Fresh tab loaded the URL directly and showed "103 car tire dealers in Atlanta, GA, USA" with cards starting BOYD TIRE CO, BUCK'S NEW AND USED TIRES INC, CANADA TIRE CO — matching the filtered + alphabetically-sorted state from the original tab.

scenarios.name: Rapid interaction: repeatedly clicking Sort/Filters controls does not crash the page
steps: Immediately after applying a Filters change, rapidly click the "Sort by" button 6x in quick succession
Poll dialog open-state
Retry a normal (non-rapid) click once the dialog closes
scenarios.expected: No crash and no lasting stuck state (boundary checklist #6).
scenarios.actual: The residual <dialog class="ds__modal"> from the just-closed Filters panel intercepted pointer events, causing one click attempt to time out after 3s of Playwright's own retries. Polling confirmed the dialog stayed open for several seconds longer than the earlier-observed ~3.6s before clearing on its own; once cleared, a normal click on "Sort by" succeeded immediately. No crash, no new console errors, document.readyState stayed "complete" throughout. Reproduces BUG-1 from a prior run.

scenarios.name: Dealer card "Contact dealer" CTA reveals contact options end-to-end
steps: Click "Contact dealer" on the first dealer card (BOYD TIRE CO)
Inspect the revealed dropdown content
scenarios.expected: Dropdown opens and reveals a contact option (e.g. Phone).
scenarios.actual: Dropdown opened directly below the CTA and revealed a "Phone" option, confirmed visually in the screenshot (a role=menu DOM query alone missed it — the two role="menu" elements on the page are Google Maps' hidden Terrain/Labels type-menus, not this dropdown; the screenshot was the reliable signal).

scenarios.name: Adjacent-element check: "Locate me" button keyboard (Tab) reachability once visible
steps: Focus the city/zip search input on /auto/dealer-locator
Confirm the Locate me button becomes visible (opacity 0→1)
Press Tab from the input
Inspect document.activeElement and the button's tabindex
Repeat in a fresh browser context (Fail Recheck Gate)
scenarios.expected: The Locate me button is reachable by Tab once it becomes visible, like any other interactive control next to a focused input.
scenarios.actual: tabindex stays "-1" permanently; Tab from the input skips straight to the next control. Reproduced identically in a second, fresh browser context. See BUG-3.

bugs.title: Filters modal's closing dialog briefly intercepts pointer events on controls behind it
steps: Open the Filters panel, select a service filter, click "See results"
Immediately try to click the "Sort by" button behind it
bugs.expected: The Filters dialog's backdrop/pointer-blocking layer clears as soon as it visually closes, so controls behind it become clickable immediately.
bugs.actual: The underlying <dialog class="ds__modal"> keeps intercepting pointer events for several seconds after "See results" is clicked (previously measured up to ~3.6s, this run's poll showed it lasting longer under rapid-click stress) before the page becomes fully interactive again. Always resolves on its own — no crash, no permanent lock. Root cause inferred from the dialog's open-attribute/pointer-interception state, not independently isolated this run (unconfirmed — isolating test not re-run since it was already established in a prior session).
bugs.impact: Only affects users who click another control immediately after applying filters, faster than the panel's close transition — low real-world impact.

bugs.title: Network-brand logo images 404 in the Filters "Networks" facet
steps: Open the Filters panel
Expand the "Networks" facet listing brand/network logos (Audi, BMW, etc.)
bugs.actual: Two logo assets returned 404: https://cdn-prod-nam.yepgarage.info/upload/network/US/.../logo-bmw.png and .../logo-audi.png — the filter labels still work, only the icon image is broken/missing. Reproduced identically from a prior run of this ticket (same two brands, same CDN).
bugs.impact: Cosmetic — broken image icon next to two brand filter options; filter functionality itself is unaffected.
bugs.consoleErrors: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 () (x2)

bugs.title: "Locate me" geolocation button on the dealer locator page is never keyboard (Tab) reachable
steps: Focus the city/zip search input
Observe the "Locate me" button becomes visible (opacity 0→1)
Press Tab from the input
Inspect document.activeElement and the button's tabindex attribute
bugs.expected: Once visible, the "Locate me" button should be reachable by keyboard Tab like any other interactive control next to a focused input.
bugs.actual: The button's tabindex stays "-1" permanently — before and after it becomes visually visible on input focus — so pressing Tab from the input skips straight over it to the next control (a "ds__btn"). Confirmed identically in the main recording session and in a second, fresh browser context (Fail Recheck Gate) on the same URL and locale — deterministic DOM fact (tabindex attribute value), no causal inference needed.
bugs.impact: Keyboard-only users can never activate geolocation search on the dealer locator page, even though it is visibly available to mouse users once the input is focused. A related (but distinct) 'invisible on load' variant of this same control was previously observed on the mobile viewport in SCRUM-68; this is the desktop, Tab-focus variant.

analytics.action: Baseline dataLayer/network listeners attached before first navigation; clicked "Find Dealers" and subsequently navigated across the dealer-locator flow
analytics.evidence: 67 analytics-related network requests captured during the session (Google Ads/GTM/DoubleClick page_view collect calls for both the homepage and /auto/dealer-locator, e.g. google.com/ccm/collect?...en=page_view&dl=...%2Fauto%2Fdealer-locator). window.dataLayer stayed at 15 entries by direct array-length check, but the network-level analytics signal alone satisfies TC-AN1's pass condition.

consoleErrors: Site-wide background noise present on every page load, not caused by any test action: a CSP violation blocking a base64 data:audio/mpeg resource under default-src *, a blocked data:application/javascript script load, and a 400 on https://dctityd.michelinman.com/status-log. Pre-existing per prior runs on this ticket and on SCRUM-68 — not re-reported as a new defect.
Two 404s for brand/network logo images in the Filters panel (see BUG-2).
observations: "New-York" in the top-cities list is hyphenated (should read "New York") — a copy/localisation nit worth flagging whenever this widget is tested; not filed as a bug since AC-2 does not govern city-name formatting.
AC-2 is met with zero margin: the top-cities list has exactly 5 cities, not more — functionally passes today but has no headroom if a city is ever removed.

The dealer results page shows a total count (e.g. "563 car tire dealers in Atlanta, GA, USA") that is far larger than the 20 cards rendered per page — no pagination/load-more control was found in the live census; out of scope for AC-1..AC-3, flagged for a future ticket.

The homepage has more than one <footer> element in the DOM — an empty modal-shell footer template appears before the real site footer (.ds__layout-footer, 134 links) — a plain document.querySelector('footer') silently picks the wrong (empty, hidden) one; worth knowing for anyone automating footer checks on this page.

The dealer card "Contact dealer" dropdown's revealed content is not inside a role="menu" element (the only two role="menu" elements on the page are Google Maps' own hidden Terrain/Labels controls) — an accessibility-role-based query for this dropdown will silently match the wrong thing; verify by screenshot or a scoped text query instead.
Map widget (Google Maps embed with dealer markers) rendered correctly on the results page but was not driven beyond visual confirmation, per the standing third-party-embed constraint.

automationGap.recommendation: Sort and filter on the dealer results page — exactly the behaviour this ticket's comment asked about — are entirely unautomated. 4 step definitions and 3 registry entries would close the gap and let S10's finding (both controls genuinely mutate the result set) run as a regression check going forward.
